You will hear Ben and Eva talking about school clubs.
Ben: Do you want to join the music club with me?
Eva: I cannot play an instrument. Can beginners join?
Ben: Yes. You can try a drum, or just sing.
Eva: I enjoy singing. Is it on Monday?
Ben: No, Monday is art club. Music club meets on Tuesday.
Eva: Does it start at four?
Ben: Usually it does, but this week it starts at half past four.
Eva: Where is it?
Ben: In the music room, beside the hall.
Eva: Do I need to bring anything?
Ben: Just a bottle of water. The school has all the instruments.
Eva: Can you meet me before the club?
Ben: Yes, by the school gate.
Eva: Great. I want to try singing with the group.
